Title: Add opt-in bearer token auth to NodeWorker endpoints
Description: NodeWorker/Program.cs exposes POST /inference, GET /metrics, GET /models, GET /health with no authentication. Add optional bearer token auth controlled by NodeWorker:Auth:RequireToken (default false) in appsettings.json. When enabled, generate a random token on first run and store in config. Disabled by default — does not break existing LAN deployments.
